verdict.left_looks: A long, low sandstone box with a crenellated parapet (alternating sand and grey blocks) and corner towers. The walls are flat terracotta-orange slabs with a few rectangular window cut-outs that read as holes through to the sky. The front has a central recessed entry with a pillar and a red carpet. There are small red and pink awning stripes at the top and a chiseled sandstone base band. The overall form is a plain, flat-walled box with little depth or detail.
verdict.right_looks: A two-storey sandstone market building on a sand plinth. It has banded terracotta and sandstone courses with a row of dark wood crate or barrel blocks as a frieze. Orange and white striped awnings with wooden posts run across the front. Goods and stalls sit under the awnings, and there are plants at the corners. The roof is stepped, with a domed sandstone mass, a small rooftop room with a window opening, parapet merlons and a flagpole. The silhouette is varied and the facade has depth and many small props.
verdict.why: The right build has a varied roofline, layered banding, awnings and market props that read clearly as a desert bazaar, while the left is a flat-walled box with sky-through window holes and little detail.
